How it works: Paste your order list below (one item per line, English or Indonesian — e.g. "Baby Potato 1 kg" or "Kentang Baby 1 kg"), pick Kitchen or Bar, then click Distribute. Kitchen items route by cheapest active supplier plus every standing rule (named-supplier locks, pantry→Mimba, thresholds). Bar produce goes to a single cheapest full-coverage supplier (Buk Bunga is backup-only). Anything unmatched lands in a clearly flagged Undistributed pool at the bottom — assign it yourself with the dropdown before copying.
How it works: Paste a price list from your tracking tool — the same "PRODUCT / LAST PRICE / DATE / QTY / AMOUNT / DELIVERIES" table you'd paste in chat. Pick which supplier those prices are for, click Preview, review the matches (fix any low-confidence ones or uncheck them), then Apply. Updates save to this browser — download the updated site afterward to make them official everywhere.
How it works: Turn a supplier off and it's skipped everywhere (cheapest-active comparisons, the bar one-supplier rule, named-supplier locks) — the same as SM/Wika/MKS/MKU/Agus being disabled today. Set a minimum order and if that supplier's running total falls under it, its items get redistributed to the next-cheapest active supplier automatically (same logic as the existing TJ 400k / BB,SJ,Sarining 200k rule — now editable instead of hardcoded). Changes apply immediately to this browser; download the updated site from the Edit Matrix tab to make them official everywhere.

Price update history

Search or sort the full supplier matrix. Disabled suppliers are shown for reference but excluded from auto-routing — manage which ones are active in the Suppliers tab. "Named supplier" shows a locked/specialty supplier pulled straight from that row's notes (AD, Dineta Jaya, Rafi, Krop Nation, Fume, Prima Pangan, etc.) — those aren't part of the cheapest-price comparison.

Paste a list of product names below (one per line — or paste a whole table, only the first column is read). By default this only removes that supplier's price/listing for those products — everyone else keeps their price. Check "all suppliers" to delete the product from the matrix entirely instead. Preview the matches before deleting anything.

Search a product to edit its prices, or add a brand-new product. Changes save to this browser immediately. To make them official everywhere (your phone, anyone else with the link), download the updated site below and re-upload it to GitHub over the old index.html.

Import updated matrix

Ask Claude in chat for "the updated supplier matrix" and it can give you either a full matrix snapshot (JSON) or a simple table — drag that file in below, or just paste the text/JSON it gives you. A screenshot can't be read automatically here (this page has no OCR/AI of its own) — instead, paste the screenshot to Claude in chat and ask it to turn it into text or JSON you can paste below.

Search a product below to lock it to one specific supplier (bypasses price comparison entirely, e.g. "Ham only from Fume") or ban it from one or more suppliers (that supplier is skipped for this product even when it's cheapest, e.g. "never order Honey Pineapple from Sedana Jaya"). Both settings save to this browser immediately, same as everywhere else in the app — download the updated site from the Edit Matrix tab to make them official everywhere. Andika (15 Sep 2026): products can also be locked two OTHER, older ways that predate this tab — a "Default → X" supplier hint set from the Edit Matrix product form, or a handful of built-in pool-internal hard locks — both are now shown alongside the locks set here, clearly labeled, so nothing is invisible anymore.
